name: mirage
text: Answers: (1) Can live profit? Unproven. The engine has only ever placed 12 live orders (10 settled, -18%), too few to tell; the one study that showed an edge (Novig lagging Pinnacle by ~6.6 s after score changes) needed the Pinnodds feed you no longer have. (2) Why no action? Several separate lanes each needed their own switches, and at the moment the master live switch was off in the config. (3) Built: v1.0.131 is out (sharp-vetoed bets no longer listed): https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.131 . v1.0.132 is building: the Live tab now opens with ONE choice, Off / Practice / Real; the old toggles are under 'Advanced live settings'. I switched the engine to Practice now: every live lane runs and records what it would bet or bid, no real money. Real mode only after about 100 practice fills show a positive edge against the close.
